Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: the display template is now applied to the parent check when transform is set. The raw summary confirms that TransformResults evaluates the parent display template and that processDisplayTemplate is extracted from processTemplates. The title is specific and matches the changeset and the linked objective (issue `#2868`).
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#2868`] requires the parent check's `display` template to be evaluated when `transform` is set. In `TransformResults` (checks/runchecks.go), the parent result `r` now calls `processDisplayTemplate(checkCtx, r)` after `r.Detail = nil` and before it is appended to `out`. The parent still skips `processTemplates`, so its `test` expression is not evaluated. The display logic moved unchanged into `processDisplayTemplate`, which `processTemplates` also calls for child results, so child behavior is preserved. The added test `TestTransformResultsAppliesDisplayToParent` checks that the parent message becomes "3 items processed" and that the parent stays passing when its test expression is `false`. I did not execute the test. The verdict relies on the diff, which shows the test's expected behavior.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changes support the `#2868` objective. The `processDisplayTemplate` extraction is a small refactor that lets the parent and child paths share the display logic. The new test covers the parent display and pass/fail behavior. No unrelated changes appear in the reviewed diff of checks/runchecks.go or checks/runchecks_test.go.
